content_sections.heading: About DPMU Haveri
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Programme Management Unit of the National Health Mission, in the office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, District Administrative Building, Devagiri, Haveri, under the Government of Karnataka and Zilla Panchayat Haveri. It states that the posts are sanctioned and vacant under various national health programmes and PM-ABHIM in the district, and that they are filled with the approval of the Chief Executive Officer of the Zilla Panchayat and the President of the District Health and Family Welfare Society.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 59 posts across 21 designations. The table follows the notice's programme-wise break-up. The notice gives a reservation roster for each group of posts. The rows below show the main categories as printed; the notice also gives the break-up by women, rural, disabled, ex-servicemen, Kannada medium, project-displaced, third gender and sports persons, with reservation points. The Medical Officer roster points are 1–3 (NP-NCDs), 4–9 (ICU/HDU) and 10–13 (PM-ABHIM Namma Clinic). The nursing roster points are 250–253 (MH), 254–258 (CH), 259–262 (ICU/HDU), 263–265 (PM-ABHIM) and 266–267 (NP-NCDs). The Psychiatric Nurse, Psychologist, Audiologist/Speech Therapist, Optometrist and Physiotherapist posts are each shown under the general category.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: For the Psychiatric Nurse, the notice lists a PG diploma in psychiatric nursing from an institution recognised by the Nursing Council of India as desirable. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The notice prints an age limit only for Nursing Officer (MHU): maximum 45 years. For the other posts it says that pay and age limit are to be fixed as per NHM/NUHM norms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice prints no pay amount for any post and says pay and age limit are to be fixed as per NHM/NUHM norms. All posts are filled on contract basis. The notice does not give the length of the contract. Appointments are made on merit and roster (reservation) basis. The Society reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts.

content_sections.text: Application forms are issued and received at the office named for each post, between 10:30 AM and 5:30 PM on any day from 5 November 2026 to 16 November 2026. Candidates must be present in person, collect the form, and submit it with the documents on the same day. Applications sent online, by registered post or by e-mail are not considered. Go to the office listed for your post during 10:30 AM to 5:30 PM, between 5 November 2026 and 16 November 2026. Collect the prescribed application form from the concerned programme section. Fill in the form and attach self-attested photocopies of the original documents and 2 copies of your recent photograph. Submit the application at the same office on the same day. Contact details on the letterhead: e-mail [email protected] , phone 08375-298927, fax 08375-249009. The notice says that applications sent by e-mail are not considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DPMU Haveri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 59 posts in 21 designations, including 13 Medical Officers, 19 Nursing Officers (18 plus 1 for MHU), 8 Lab Technicians and 10 Primary Health Safety Officers.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are issued and received from 5 November 2026 to 16 November 2026, between 10:30 AM and 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply online or by post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says applications sent online, by registered post or by e-mail are not considered. Candidates must appear in person at the concerned office.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Medical Officer?
faq.answer: MBBS pass with compulsory internship and KMC registration, plus the Convocation/Degree Certificate. For NP-NCDs, a minimum of 3 years' hospital work experience is also required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Nursing Officer?
faq.answer: Female Nursing Officers (MH, CH, ICU/HDU) need a General Nursing Diploma from an institution recognised by the Karnataka Government and Karnataka Nursing Council registration. PM-ABHIM Nursing Officers need B.Sc or Diploma in Nursing. Other nursing posts have their own conditions listed above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice prints a limit only for Nursing Officer (MHU): maximum 45 years.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the posts are filled on contract basis under National Health Mission programmes and PM-ABHIM.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The notice says appointment is made on merit and roster (reservation) basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where do I apply for the Nursing Officer (MHU) and X-Ray Technician posts?
faq.answer: At the office of the District Tuberculosis Eradication Officer, District Hospital premises, Haveri, between 10:30 AM and 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Self-attested photocopies of the original documents and 2 copies of a recent photograph, along with marks cards and caste or other reservation certificates as listed in the notice.
